about.heading: Curiosity, made useful.
about.statement: Good technology makes the complicated feel possible.
paragraphs: I'm a B.Tech Artificial Intelligence & Data Science student at R.M.K. College of Engineering & Technology in Chennai. I enjoy the whole path from a difficult question to an experience someone can understand and use.

My work moves between machine learning, evidence-grounded agents and full-stack engineering. Recent projects explore inherited-risk education, safer agriculture, exoplanet detection and document intelligence.
I care about clear explanations, privacy, reproducibility and human judgement. A fictional demo, a prototype and an operational product deserve different claims, and I keep those boundaries visible.
points: B.Tech in Artificial Intelligence & Data Science, R.M.K. College of Engineering & Technology.
Building AI agents, machine-learning systems and full-stack applications.
Exploring healthcare, agriculture, space science and document intelligence.
Ambassador, Zoho Catalyst program.
2 internships: data science (Virtual Tech Services) and in-plant training (Chennai Port Authority).

projects.title: KinSight — Inherited-Risk Navigator
projects.description: A multilingual screening-result navigator with couple consent, a counsellor console, referrals and a chat/voice assistant. Seven languages, accessible explanations and a traceable audit trail; all people and results are synthetic.
projects.imageAlt: KinSight concept illustration, not a screenshot of the application
points: Explains screening results in plain language in seven languages (English, Arabic, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam), with right-to-left layout for Arabic.
A deterministic genetics engine produces every number. The couple view opens only after both partners agree; higher-risk cases also need a counsellor.
Tamper-evident audit log. Fictional demo: all people and results are synthetic.

projects.title: Solarda — Agentic Smart Agriculture
projects.description: LangGraph farm agents combine irrigation planning, plant-disease vision, sensor forecasting and a six-language Gemini assistant. A deterministic safety engine and human approval govern actions. Uses replayed data; the hosted preview needs a backend for agent features.
projects.imageAlt: Solarda concept illustration, not a screenshot of the application
points: LangGraph farm workflow where agents only propose actions: a deterministic TypeScript safety engine decides what runs, risky actions wait for a human, the gate fails closed if the API is down, and every action is logged.
Plant-disease classifier (EfficientNetV2-B0, ONNX) that abstains when unsure: 98.2% on PlantVillage, 61.0% on PlantDoc field photos, and 87% correct on the images it chooses to answer.
Crop and soil-water twin (Chennai 2021-23 weather) used about 19-32% less water than a rule-based controller at similar yield. Results come from replayed data and simulation, not live sensors.
Hosted UI uses replayed data and needs a backend for agent features.
projects.outcome: Abstains on 60% of field photos and is 87% right when it answers.

projects.title: ExoDetect — Exoplanet Detection
projects.description: Kepler light-curve processing, transit features and a calibrated XGBoost classifier for the ISRO Bhartiya Antariksh Hackathon 2026. The dashboard runs exported ONNX inference in the browser; heavy light-curve analysis stays in Python.
projects.imageAlt: ExoDetect concept illustration, not a screenshot of the application
points: Pipeline from raw Kepler light curves (Savitzky-Golay detrending, BLS period search, 13 transit features) to a star-level 70/15/15 split, so one star never lands in two splits.
XGBoost with isotonic calibration, a threshold picked on validation only, and TreeSHAP explanations, exported to ONNX so the classifier runs in the browser.
On a 400-star sample, AUC-PR fell to 0.913 once depth and SNR features were removed; a harder benchmark is still pending.
Browser ONNX inference; heavy light-curve analysis remains in Python.
projects.outcome: 0.913 test AUC-PR without depth and SNR features, on the v1 sample of 400 stars.

projects.title: Legal & Regulatory Assurance Platform
projects.description: An evidence-first platform for contract intelligence, regulatory change and compliance workflows. Source provenance, scoped access and human review form the foundation; integrated legal analysis and summary workflows remain in development.
projects.imageAlt: Legal intelligence concept illustration, not a screenshot of the application
points: Secure document intake (hashing, quarantine), TXT/DOCX/PDF extraction with page-level locators, and a resolver that returns exact stored quotes.
In development: contract and regulatory analysis are still planned. Intake and extraction live on the PR #13 branch until merged.
projects.outcome: 126 / 126 scope, session and API regression checks passed; 32 / 32 native extraction checks passed.

projects.title: eRTMAC-NWIS — Nearby Wells Intelligence
projects.description: Drilling-advisory prototype: nearby-well search, formation correlation and evidence-grounded advisories using PostGIS, local retrieval and LangGraph. Built for SIH 2026 problem SIH26121 on a synthetic demo dataset (not Oil India data) with replayed telemetry; advisory-only, with an engineer making decisions.
projects.imageAlt: Nearby wells concept illustration, not a screenshot of the application
points: Drilling-advisory prototype: ranks offset wells by similarity instead of distance alone and ties each risk estimate to a source report and page.
A four-agent LangGraph flow answers with citations or says the evidence is insufficient; role-based access and a hash-chained audit log.
Runs on a synthetic 12-well dataset with replayed telemetry; risk scores are uncalibrated and it is advisory-only, not an operational decision system.
projects.outcome: 200 backend tests passed and 8 / 8 held-out benchmark cases, all on synthetic data.

projects.title: EduNova — Gamified Science Learning
projects.description: Story-driven biology, chemistry and physics learning worlds with video quests, quizzes and a parent/teacher portal. Interactive Three.js scenes and React Three Fiber shaders support the learning experience.
projects.imageAlt: EduNova concept illustration, not a screenshot of the application
points: Three video-quest worlds (Biology, Chemistry, Physics) with quizzes, built with Next.js 15 and React Three Fiber.
Interactive 3D scenes plus parent and teacher views. Learning demo.
projects.outcome: Three worlds with 31, 17 and 15 video checkpoints.
